frequency_question: How often are such treaties successfully renewed prior to formal expiration?
membership_rule: Includes major international transboundary water treaties with fixed multi-decade terms that came up for renewal between neighboring developing countries. Excludes minor local administrative arrangements or treaties terminated by outright military conflict.
window: Within the final 12 months preceding expiration
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named; population is small as major 30-year water treaties are rare, but historical continuity rate for technical water sharing is exceptionally high.
known_gaps: Limited global sample size of exact 30-year transboundary water treaties in South Asia.
skeleton: Comparable historical renewal instances for major long-term bilateral water pacts
multiplier: 4 observed historical precedents across similar diplomatic frameworks
validity_reason: Global norms regarding transboundary water treaties evolve slowly over decades.
